document: 1985 Pontiac Fiero Do It Yourself manual
finding: Step 15 explicitly prints 8 N·m (6 ft. lbs.) for the black plastic outer bezel’s two side retaining screws, then repeats 8 N·m (6 ft. lbs.) for the two front bezel retaining screws after closing the front compartment lid. The visible numeral is 8, not 0.8.
context: Step 14 separately discusses locating the headlight retainer tabs in aiming-screw slots. The torque stated in step 15 is for bezel retaining screws, not aiming screws.
status: Existing guide value agrees with this printed primary page; no app or source-guide change made.
limits: Independent reading of this original printed page does not establish the absence of later factory corrections or validate tightening on the physical car.
